thread:
maria: quick heads-up — on Console > Models list (compact density) the right-side action strip buttons have hitboxes that overlap the row click area. I clicked the kebab twice and it navigated instead :grimacing:
jon: can repro. looks like we pulled the action-strip closer with a negative margin. which browser/os?
maria: mac chrome, latest. repro steps: compact table, hover actions, click icon then immediately click empty area — often triggers row click.
kelly: hmm, I remember we tightened tokens to save space. that reduced padding. can we expand only the interactive area without changing visual density?
leo: alternative: keep visual tokens but increase internal padding on the button (pseudo hitbox) or add a slightly larger :before clickable layer. avoid adjusting the global spacing tokens.
maria: prefer internal hitbox expansion — changing tokens will ripple everywhere. also we should consider pointer-events: none on the container except when a11y focus/hover active so we're not accidentally intercepting events.
jon: quick prototype I tried added `pointer-events: auto` on the button and `pointer-events: none` on the strip when not hovered. that reduces misclicks but keyboard focus needs to be preserved.
kelly: can you paste the CSS you tried?
jon: ```css
.action-strip { pointer-events: none; }
.action-strip:hover, .action-strip:focus-within { pointer-events: auto; }
.action-strip button { padding: 6px 8px; /* keep visual density */ }
```
kelly: neat. keyboard focus still lands on buttons? need to test with tabbing. if pointer-events none is applied, focus might skip — so ensure :focus-within triggers the property.
leo: also accessibility note on toasts — current copy is often just "Saved" which is ambiguous with multiple types of saves. we should include noun/context in the toast copy and ARIA announcement. e.g. "Model saved" or "Policy saved: 3 changes".
maria: yes — saw a bug where two queued toasts both said "Saved" and screen reader user couldn't tell which saved.
design-bot: proposed toast copy patterns: ["Model saved", "Policy updated", "Deployment started"]. For generic success without context, use aria-live=\"polite\" and include an offscreen descriptive label: `aria-label=\"Model saved: 3 changes\"`. For errors use assertive announce. Keep brief but specific.
jon: action items: 1) frontend: implement pointer-events approach with focus-within fallback + bump internal button padding; add cypress e2e that ensures row click not triggered when action clicked. 2) design: provide toast copy variants for common flows.
kelly: i'll mock a prototype using the pointer-events + focus-within approach and post screenshots by Tue. also will propose copy variants in the same thread.
maria: thanks. tagging @frontend for visibility. will watch for the cypress test.
leo: small follow-up: if pointer-events trick causes weirdness in mobile/touch, fallback to increasing horizontal tap target to 44px. please test on iPhone simulator.
jon: noted — i'll run mobile emulation.
design-bot: summary: fix hitbox via internal padding or pointer-events w/ focus-within, avoid changing global spacing tokens; update toast copy to include context and ensure aria-live semantics. :white_check_mark:
